messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server, ShinyIncubator, R 3.0.0, and devtools playing nice
parts:
Shiny Server should work fine with R 3.0.0. Had you heard otherwise?

Note that if your server previously had R 2.x installed then your libraries all need to be upgraded. I think in theory running upgrade.packages(checkBuilt=TRUE) would do it--you'd need to run it both as root and as each user that has packages installed.


On Wed, May 15, 2013 at 2:05 PM, Richard Hahn <rho....@gmail.com> wrote:
I'm wondering what the status is of getting Shiny Server over to R 3.0.0.

I want to use the isolation() function, which I believe requires Shiny Incubator, which requires devtools.  The new version of which requires R 3.0.0.

So I gather from an Apr 26 post (https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/3.0/shiny-discuss/DPSXuzyw90M/3HU4amOrh5sJ)
that the solution is to run the old dev tools and run R 2.15.3.

I'm just confirming that this is still the right solution.  

If so it may be worth mentioning here (http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#isolation) that one would need to get the previous version of devtools, because Shiny Server doesn't work with 3.0.0 yet.  I upgraded to R 3.0.0 precisely because of the code snippet at the isolation tutorial pointing me to devtools which in turn told me I needed the newest R, only to find out after the fact that Shiny Server simply won't work with it.

Anyway, you guys move fast, so maybe there is going to be a move of Shiny Server over to 3.0.0 tomorrow, so I thought I'd check.

Thanks for the nice software.
